Message:
tcp: refactor tcp_ecn_check_ce to remove sk type cast

Refactor tcp_ecn_check_ce and __tcp_ecn_check_ce to accept struct sock*
instead of tcp_sock* to clean up type casts. This is a pure refactor
patch.
